geometry.rootPolicy: flat sole and low rounded mound, no exposed pointed/finger roots

individualMeadowClearance.scope: each actual current meadow instance transformed geometry AABB enlarged .018 for sway; finite current layout

meadowEnvelopeClearance.scope: all actual current meadow site centers against complete rectangle with conservative .52 radius; .48 cluster limit plus .018 sway rounded up, not physical plant/actor contact or all scene meshes

originalSpriteEnvelopeClearance.method: sphere enclosing all four full raw Sprite quad corners from actual world scale/center; sphere-to-conservative-3D-pose-envelope distance; includes faint/transparent corners without cropping

shoreline.method: every actual dry-land boundary segment against full projected rectangle, including crossing and endpoint/corner distances

waterBacking.scope: actual wet backing under dry land, no water physics

placement.limits: one unchanged default-world off-road authored placement,5sole rays,finite walkability,actual road triangles and conservative full-card envelopes; no owner-world placement, anatomical fit or all-camera visibility guarantee

scope: actual finite triangle topology and connected-shell witnesses, current Scene4 support/road/card/shore/meadow audits and finite camera framing; authored standalone mesh candidate only
